introduction: This spec conditionally adds AgentKit's code_search tool — backed by a single codesearch.Index built once per run and shared by every phase — to every phase of issue, fix, spec and impl, so that ranked, indexed search is available alongside the six read tools when baseline measurements justify it.

glossary.BuiltinTools: The []string field on agentrun.Phase naming which tools from tools.All to register for that phase. code_search is appended here conditionally, not to ReadOnlyFileTools.
glossary.Index: An implementation of tools.Index (defined in AgentKit's root module) that provides ranked code search over a repository. Built once per run by codesearch.New and closed at run end.
glossary.Invalidate: A method on tools.Index that marks the entire index (or a subtree) as stale so the next code_search call rebuilds the affected parts lazily, rather than returning results from a tree state that no longer exists.
glossary.ReadOnlyFileTools: The var in internal/agentrun/policy.go listing the unconditional read-only built-in tools every phase gets: read_file, list_files, find_files, search_files (and file_outline, find_symbol after spec 15).
glossary.codesearch module: The separate Go module github.com/agentfox/agentkit-go/codesearch, with its own go.mod, that builds a zoekt-backed index and returns a tools.Index.

requirements.title: Index wiring through Config and Options
requirements.rationale: The index is a per-run resource shared by every phase. Placing it on agentrun.Config lets registeredTools pass it to tools.Options without any per-tool change to phase-building code. Each tool's Options also carries it for the pipeline's invalidation calls.

criteria.action: pass r.cfg.Index as the Index field of tools.Options so that tools.All includes code_search when the index is non-nil

requirements.title: code_search in every phase's tool grant
requirements.rationale: code_search is not added to ReadOnlyFileTools because it exists only when an index is present. Appending it conditionally to each phase's BuiltinTools makes the presence explicit and prevents SelectTools from looking for a tool that tools.All did not return.

criteria.system: each tool pipeline (issue, fix, spec, impl)
criteria.action: append "code_search" to every phase's BuiltinTools before the phase is run, checked once per pipeline at the top of its Run function
leave every phase's BuiltinTools unchanged so that SelectTools never looks for code_search

criteria.condition: a Config with a non-nil Index and a Phase whose BuiltinTools includes "code_search" is run
criteria.action: include code_search in the resolved tool set returned by registeredTools
criteria.contract: the resolved []core.Tool contains a tool named "code_search"

criteria.condition: a Config with a nil Index and a Phase whose BuiltinTools includes "code_search" is run
criteria.action: exclude code_search from the resolved tool set because tools.All did not return it
criteria.contract: the resolved []core.Tool does not contain a tool named "code_search"

criteria.action: keep code_search absent from ReadOnlyFileTools and from MutatingTools

requirements.title: Index lifecycle in cmd/ entry points
requirements.rationale: The index is built once before the Runner is constructed and closed on every exit path. Building it in the cmd/ entry point keeps the lifecycle outside the pipeline and ensures the defer runs regardless of how the pipeline exits.

criteria.condition: a cmd/ entry point's Exec function starts
criteria.system: each cmd/ entry point (issue, fix, spec, impl)
criteria.action: call codesearch.New(ctx, ws) to build the index before constructing the Runner, and pass the resulting index to both agentrun.Config.Index and the tool's Options.Index
defer index.Close() so the index is closed on every exit path including failure, cancellation and panic
call Close on the index exactly once per run, verified by a test double that records Close calls on success, failure and context cancellation

criteria.condition: codesearch.New returns codesearch.ErrUnsupported or any other error
criteria.action: set Index to nil, emit a low warning with code code_search_unavailable, and continue the run without code_search
criteria.contract: the run proceeds to completion; the envelope contains a warning with code code_search_unavailable and severity low

criteria.action: build the index at most once per run and never rebuild it mid-run

requirements.title: Index invalidation after tree changes
requirements.rationale: fix and impl change the working tree between phases. Without invalidation, code_search would return results from a stale tree. Invalidate("") marks the entire index as stale so the next query rebuilds lazily. Conservative invalidation is correct: a false positive is a no-op, a false negative returns stale results.

criteria.condition: codefix.Run calls git.CreateBranch between the analyse and implement phases
criteria.action: call Index.Invalidate("") after the branch creation and before the implement phase starts, guarded with if o.Index != nil

criteria.condition: codeimpl creates or checks out a branch (git.CreateBranch or git.Checkout) before the survey phase
criteria.action: call Index.Invalidate("") after the branch operation and before the survey phase, guarded with if o.Index != nil

criteria.condition: codeimpl calls revertSpecDir and dropScratchFiles in runTask before the gate run
criteria.action: call Index.Invalidate("") after the revert and drop and before the gate run, guarded with if o.Index != nil

criteria.condition: codeimpl calls discard (reset + clean) when a task attempt fails and is retried
criteria.action: call Index.Invalidate("") after the discard and before the next attempt, guarded with if o.Index != nil

criteria.condition: codeimpl calls git.CommitAll when a task lands
criteria.action: call Index.Invalidate("") after the commit and before the next task's implementation phase, guarded with if o.Index != nil

criteria.condition: codeimpl's runRepair commits its own tree changes
criteria.action: call Index.Invalidate("") after the repair commit and before the first task, guarded with if o.Index != nil

criteria.condition: codeimpl's repairAfterTask commits its tree changes
criteria.action: call Index.Invalidate("") after the repair-after-task commit and before the task's own commit, guarded with if o.Index != nil

criteria.condition: the tool is issue or spec
criteria.action: never call Invalidate because these tools never change the working tree

requirements.title: Warning code for unavailable index
requirements.rationale: A structured warning code lets envelope consumers distinguish an unavailable index from other warnings. The preflight stage is correct because the index is built during setup before any model phase.

criteria.action: declare WarnCodeSearchUnavailable WarnCode = "code_search_unavailable" as a constant
map WarnCodeSearchUnavailable to stage "preflight" in warnStages
include WarnCodeSearchUnavailable in the slice returned by DeclaredWarnCodes()

requirements.title: Read-only invariant preserved
requirements.rationale: code_search reads the index; it does not write to the workspace. AssertReadOnly checks against MutatingTools, so adding code_search to a phase's grant must not break the read-only invariant.

criteria.action: keep code_search absent from MutatingTools so that AssertReadOnly never rejects it

criteria.condition: a read-only phase's resolved tool set includes code_search
criteria.action: return nil (no error), confirming the read-only invariant holds

requirements.title: Preflight reports index availability
requirements.rationale: The preflight check is informational: the fallback is search_files, so the check never refuses the run. It lets operators see whether code_search is available before committing to a full run.

criteria.condition: RunPreflight is called and the index was built
criteria.system: each tool's RunPreflight (issue, fix, spec, impl)
criteria.action: include a PreflightCheck with check "code_search_index", ok true, and detail "built"

criteria.condition: RunPreflight is called and the index was not built
criteria.action: include a PreflightCheck with check "code_search_index", ok true, and detail "unavailable: <reason>" where reason is the error message from codesearch.New
set the code_search_index check's ok field to true regardless of whether the index was built, because the check is informational and search_files is the fallback

requirements.title: go.mod gains the codesearch module
requirements.rationale: The codesearch module has its own go.mod (like difftest/), so it needs its own replace directive. The existing replace for agentkit-go does not cover sub-modules.

criteria.action: add a require directive for github.com/agentfox/agentkit-go/codesearch
add a replace directive mapping github.com/agentfox/agentkit-go/codesearch to ../agentkit-go/codesearch, matching the existing replace pattern for the root agentkit-go module

requirements.title: Documentation updates
requirements.rationale: Steering directives require updating all affected documentation when a spec implementation changes user-facing or developer-facing surfaces.

criteria.action: list code_search alongside the six read tools in each tool's "What the model may and may not do" section, with a note that it is available when the index is built, and add the code_search_index check entry to each tool's --preflight example

execution_paths.title: Successful run with code_search available in every phase

steps.action: invokes a cmd/ entry point (e.g. fix) with a valid input
calls codesearch.New(ctx, ws) and receives a non-nil index; defers index.Close()
passes the index to both agentrun.Config.Index and the tool's Options.Index, then calls Run
detects non-nil Index and appends "code_search" to every phase's BuiltinTools
passes Config.Index as tools.Options.Index to tools.All, which returns code_search in the tool set
calls code_search alongside the six read tools to navigate the codebase
deferred index.Close() runs on exit, closing the index exactly once

execution_paths.title: Run continues without code_search when the index cannot be built

steps.action: invokes a cmd/ entry point on a platform where codesearch is unsupported
calls codesearch.New(ctx, ws) and receives an error (e.g. ErrUnsupported)
sets Index to nil, emits a low warning with code code_search_unavailable, and continues
detects nil Index and leaves every phase's BuiltinTools unchanged
passes nil Index to tools.All, which does not return code_search
navigates the codebase using only the six read tools; the run completes normally
